entries.label: EWSR1::ERG

sections.text: EWSR1::ERG is a molecularly confirmed Ewing sarcoma fusion. A primary clinicopathological cohort included 26 tumors with this fusion, with round, ovoid, spindle or epithelioid morphology.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: EWSR1::ETV1

sections.text: EWSR1::ETV1 is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion documented in clinical translocation-testing data and in a molecularly characterized Ewing sarcoma cohort.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: EWSR1::ETV4

sections.text: EWSR1::ETV4 is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion documented in molecularly characterized tumors. The reviewed cohort included an infant with an EWSR1::ETV4-positive paraspinal/pelvic soft-tissue tumor containing prominent calcification.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: EWSR1::FEV

sections.text: EWSR1::FEV is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion. Molecular analysis demonstrates EWSR1 joined to FEV with retention of the FEV ETS DNA-binding domain; directly studied tumors show primitive round-cell morphology.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: EWSR1::WT1

sections.text: EWSR1::WT1 is an oncogenic transcriptional regulator of desmoplastic small round cell tumor. Fusion-depletion experiments reduce active chromatin, three-dimensional enhancer contacts and direct target-gene expression; coexpression of its +KTS and −KTS splice isoforms generated DSRCT-like xenografts in a mesothelial-cell model.

curation_notes: Primary functional citation and regimen-specific survival review remain pending; no numerical prognosis assigned.
Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: EWSR1::DDIT3

sections.text: Trabectedin has a US histology-based indication for adults with unresectable or metastatic liposarcoma after an anthracycline-containing regimen; DDIT3 fusion status is not the sole eligibility criterion.
EWSR1::DDIT3 is a myxoid liposarcoma fusion confirmed by RNA sequencing. A directly documented tumor had diffuse DDIT3 expression despite a negative DDIT3 break-apart FISH result.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: FUS::ATF1

sections.text: FUS::ATF1 is a recognized rare fusion in angiomatoid fibrous histiocytoma. It has also been directly documented in a peritoneal mesothelioma in a primary genomic cohort.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up access attempts remained unsuccessful for the original FUS::ATF1 AFH reports; AFH association remains reference-supported.
Primary-reviewed association applies to the peritoneal mesothelioma observation; AFH association remains classification-supported because original AFH case bodies were inaccessible.
No fusion-specific functional transformation mechanism is asserted; the directly reviewed mesothelioma association and the remaining AFH primary-access gap are separately scoped.

entries.label: FUS::CREB3L1

sections.text: FUS::CREB3L1 is a recurrent fusion in low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma. An international cohort recorded this fusion in six molecularly analyzed LGFMS patients.

curation_notes: FUS::CREB3L1 is rarer than FUS::CREB3L2; no numerical or breakpoint-specific prognosis assigned.
Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: CIC::DUX4

sections.text: CIC::DUX4 acts as a transcriptional activator in CIC-rearranged sarcoma. In patient-derived cell models, fusion depletion reduced active chromatin and direct target-gene expression, including ETV1, ETV4 and ETV5; primary tumors shared the associated active chromatin pattern.
In a retrospective comparison, a 57-patient CIC-rearranged sarcoma control cohort had worse overall survival than 22 followed patients with BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

entries.label: BCOR::CCNB3
tumor_contexts: BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma of bone or soft tissue

sections.text: BCOR::CCNB3 is associated with a round-to-spindle-cell sarcoma group. Primary molecular analyses demonstrated the BCOR exon 15–CCNB3 exon 5 junction and inversion-associated FISH pattern, with an expression profile distinct from Ewing and CIC-rearranged sarcomas.

In a molecularly confirmed BCOR::CCNB3 series, the 22 patients with follow-up had a five-year overall survival estimate of 72%, better than the historical CIC-rearranged sarcoma control cohort. Seven of nine evaluable tumors treated with Ewing-type chemotherapy showed 60–100% treatment-related necrosis or fibrosis.

curation_notes: Primary follow-up audit 2026-11-27: retained statements are restricted to inspected Results, tables and figures; article-specific scope is recorded in audit-followup-sarcoma.json.

decisions.label: EWSR1::FEV

evidence.scope: Direct EWSR1-FEV/FUS-FEV cases; targeted RNA sequencing demonstrates EWSR1 exon 8-FEV exon 2; all sequenced fusions retain FEV ETS DNA-binding exon 3.

decisions.rationale: Results 3.3 and Figure 3 establish fusion sequence/domain retention; Table 1 and Figure 1 establish direct tumor association. Avoided extrapolated cell-identity reprogramming or pooled FUS/FEV prognosis.
decisions.replacement_text: EWSR1::FEV is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion. Molecular analysis demonstrates EWSR1 joined to FEV with retention of the FEV ETS DNA-binding domain; directly studied tumors show primitive round-cell morphology.

decisions.label: EWSR1::WT1

evidence.location: Results: EWS-WT1 depletion leads to strong changes in chromatin activity and 3D connectivity; Figures 3, 5 and 6
evidence.scope: Indexed full Results and figure legends: depletion reduces active chromatin and direct target expression; EWS prion-like domain mutants lose binding/activation; coexpression of KTS isoforms generates DSRCT-like xenografts.

decisions.rationale: Primary Results and Figures 3/5/6 establish fusion-dependent transcription and tumor formation in specified model; removed generalized intra-abdominal dissemination statement. No clinical CDK4/6 benefit inferred from preclinical experiments.

evidence.scope: Fusion-targeted RNA sequencing detected EWSR1-DDIT3 in a myxoid liposarcoma with negative DDIT3 break-apart FISH and diffuse DDIT3 expression. No direct EWSR1-DDIT3 differentiation-block experiment.

decisions.rationale: Results and Figure 2 provide direct molecularly confirmed myxoid liposarcoma observation; FUS-DDIT3 adipogenic mechanism is not extrapolated.
decisions.replacement_text: EWSR1::DDIT3 is a myxoid liposarcoma fusion confirmed by RNA sequencing. A directly documented tumor had diffuse DDIT3 expression despite a negative DDIT3 break-apart FISH result.

evidence.scope: Direct observation in peritoneal mesothelioma only; does not upgrade the AFH association or establish a functional transformation mechanism.

decisions.rationale: The reviewed primary FET-CREB cohort had FUS::ATF1 in mesothelioma, not AFH. Retained AFH association only as explicit classification-supported content; removed functional extrapolation. Follow-up attempted original PMID11063792 DOI10.1016/S0165-4608(00)00237-5 and PMID12218455 LWW publisher full text; only abstracts/repository abstracts obtained. Later primary AFH series had no FUS-positive cases and cannot substitute as direct validation. A separate directly inspected primary cohort documents FUS-ATF1 in peritoneal mesothelioma (not AFH), now added as a precisely scoped tumor observation.
decisions.replacement_text: FUS::ATF1 is a recognized rare fusion in angiomatoid fibrous histiocytoma. It has also been directly documented in a peritoneal mesothelioma in a primary genomic cohort.
